Rashi on Chullin 45b:11:1.english: Rabbi ruled - An actual case came before him, and he ruled stringently and did not rely on his [own] words.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:12:1.hebrew: רוב עורו - אם נחתך רוב היקף עורו סביב, אע"פ שהמוח לא נפרד כלום — טרפה:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:12:1.english: A majority of its membrane - If a majority of the circumference of its membrane around [it] was severed, even though the nerve tissue did not separate at all, [the animal is] a tereifa.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:12:2.hebrew: ואמרי לה רוב מוחו - דכיון שנפסק ונפרד המוח מבפנים, אע"ג שהעור כולו קיים — טרפה:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:12:2.english: And some say, a majority of its nerve tissue - For since the nerve tissue is severed and separated from within, even though the membrane is entirely intact, [the animal is] a tereifa.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:13:1.hebrew: כ"ש רוב עורו - שהרי רוב העור מחזיקו, וכיון שנפסק העור — סוף המוח לפרד ולצאת:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:13:1.english: All the more so, a majority of its membrane - For the majority of the membrane holds it [in place]; and once the membrane is severed, the nerve tissue will ultimately separate and come out.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:14:1.english: Nayyoli - The name of a Sage.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:15:1.hebrew: בדיק ברוב עורו - ואשכח דלא איפסיק רוביה, והדר בעי למיבדק ברוב מוחו, דניהוי נמי קיים:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:15:1.english: [He] checked the majority of its membrane - And found that its majority was not severed, and then wanted to check the majority of its nerve tissue, that it too should be intact.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:16:1.hebrew: נתמרך פסול נתמסמס פסול גרסינן - ואחוט השדרה קאי. אע"ג דהמסמסה קילא מהמרכה, כדמפרש ואזיל, אפילו הכי תנא תרווייהו; דאי תנא המסמסה לחודה, הוה מפרשינן דהיינו נשפך כקיתון. המרכה — לשון מורך, שנתרככה ונעשית המוח בתוך הקרום כמים, ונשפך מראשו לסופו ומסופו לראשו, ואם היו נוקבין אותו, היה יוצא דרך הנקב:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:16:1.english: “If it was liquefied, it is unfit; if it was softened, it is unfit” is the textual reading - And it refers to the spinal cord. Even though softening is less severe than liquefaction, as [the Gemara] goes on to explain, even so, he taught both of them; for had he taught softening alone, we would have explained that it means [being] poured out like a jug. Hamrakha is an expression of softness [morekh], in that it softened and the marrow inside the membrane became like water, and it pours from its top to its bottom and from its bottom to its top; and if they were to puncture it, it would exit through the hole.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:17:1.hebrew: ואינו יכול לעמוד - מפני שנעשה צלול, אבל לא כל כך שיהיה נשפך כקיתון של מים; אבל כשאוחזין אותו ומניח קצתו למעלה מידו, הוא נכפף ונופל:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:17:1.english: And it cannot stand - Because it has become fluid, but not so much that it would pour like a jug of water; rather, when one holds it and leaves a portion of it above his hand, it bends and falls.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:17:2.hebrew: מפני כבדו - שהוא עב וכבד, אבל לא נתרכך מבפנים — מהו? חולי הוא זה שמכבידו, או לא? וכל הני, נתמרך ונתמסמס, בכלל "נפסק החוט" הן, דקים להו לרבנן שמתוך ליקוי זה עתיד לינקב וליפסק; אי נמי, אין פיסוק גדול מזה. אע"ג דאמרן "מוח זה לא מעלה ולא מוריד", ה"מ בהפרדה, אבל בהמרכה לא:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:17:2.english: Due to its weight - That it is thick and heavy, but did not soften on the inside — what is [the ruling]? Is this an illness that weighs it down, or not? And all these [cases] — [where the spinal cord] liquefied and softened — are included in [the category of] "the [spinal] cord was severed," for it is clear to the Sages that as a result of this defect it is destined to become perforated and severed; alternatively, there is no greater severing than this. Even though we said, "This nerve tissue makes no difference," this statement applies [only] to [physical] separation, but to liquefaction, it does not [apply].

Rashi on Chullin 45b:17:3.english: Teiku - And every teiku concerning a prohibition [is resolved] stringently.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:17:4.english: [If] it softened, [it is] unfit - As you said [above].

Rashi on Chullin 45b:17:5.hebrew: נתמזמז כשר - ולהכי הדר נקט "נתמסמס פסול", דלא תימא נתמזמז ונתמסמס חדא הוא, ולאיפלוגי עליה אתא:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:17:5.english: [If] it was emptied, it is kosher - And this is why [they] went back and mentioned “[if] it softened, [it is] unfit” — so that you should not say that nitmazmez and nitmasmes are one [and the same thing], and [Bei Rav] came to disagree with him [Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi].

Rashi on Chullin 45b:17:6.english: Was emptied - Part of the marrow was emptied out on its own:

Rashi on Chullin 45b:18:1.english: Banged it - Mincier [to crush], in Old French.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:18:2.hebrew: נתמזמז מוחיה דדין - דואג היה עליו, ואומר: אוי לו לזה שנתמזמז מוחו:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:18:2.english: This [man’s] brain has dissolved - He was distressed for him, and said: “Woe to this [man] whose brain has dissolved!”

Rashi on Chullin 45b:18:3.hebrew: שאינו מוליד - תולדות האיש מן המוח היא באה, שגיד הנשה של ירך וגיד הגוייה כולן מחוברין לחוט השדרה, שהוא מתפצל ויוצא מתחת השדרה, ונעשה גיד אצל הירכים ונכנס לתוכו:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:18:3.english: That he cannot reproduce - A man's offspring comes from the brain, for the sciatic nerve of the thigh and the organ of the body [i.e., the reproductive organ] are all connected to the spinal cord, which branches and emerges from beneath the spine, and becomes a nerve near the thighs and enters into it.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:19:1.english: Until where [does] the spinal cord [extend] - Until where does the power of the cord [extend, for] an animal to be a tereifah upon its severance? [For] the cord emerges from the brain and runs along the entire spine and the fat tail until the end of the tail.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:19:2.hebrew: עד בין הפרשות - עד מקום שהוא מתפרש ומתפצל פצולין. כנגד הירכים הוא מתחיל ליפצל, ויוצא ראש א' לירך זו ואחד לזו, והאמצעי יורד לזנב. ולמטה מאותן פיצולין, כנגד שתי אצבעות, הוא חוזר ומתפצל עוד לג', ולמטה מהם עוד מתפצל, וכן בהרבה מקומות עד סופו. ואם נפסק מן המוח ועד בין הפרשות הללו, כל מקום שנפסק שם רובו — טרפה; ואם למטה מבין הפרשות נפסק — כבר תשש כחו, והיריכים מעמידין את שדרתו, ואינה מתה בכך:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:19:2.english: Until between the branches - Until the place where it divides and splits into branches. Opposite the thighs it begins to branch, and one head emerges to this thigh and one to that [thigh], and the middle [cord] descends to the tail. And below those branches, at [a distance] corresponding to two fingerbreadths, it branches again into three; and below them it branches yet again, and so in many places until its end. And if it was severed, from the brain until between these branches, wherever the majority of it was severed there, [the animal is] a tereifah; and if it was severed below between the branches, its strength has already weakened, and the thighs support its spine, and it does not die from this.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:1:2.english: At the opening of the pot - At the place of the connection between the neck and the skull.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:1:3.english: And the beans themselves - The brain [tissue] opposite the beans.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:20:1.hebrew: אייתי ליה גדי שמן - שחוט ומופשט, ולא היה לו שהות לעכב עד שיקרענו ויראה לו הפיצולין מבפנים, והיה מראה לו מבחוץ — שהחוט לבן הוא ונפרד מבחוץ כשנכנס בבשר האליה לכאן ולכאן מתחת לעצם:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:20:1.english: He brought him a fat kid - [It was] slaughtered and flayed, and he did not have time to delay until he tore it open and showed him the branchings from the inside, so he was going to show him from the outside — for the cord is white and separates on the outside as it enters the flesh of the rump to this side and to that side, beneath the bone.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:20:2.hebrew: ולא ידיע - החוט מבחוץ, והוא צריך לכוון עד מלא חוט השערה, שאם נפסק לכאן — טרפה, ואם נפסק לכאן — כשרה:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:20:2.english: And is not recognizable - The [spinal] cord [is not recognizable] from the outside; and he needs to pinpoint [it] to a hairsbreadth, for if it was severed to this side, [the animal is] a tereifah, and if it was severed to that side, [it is] kosher.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:20:3.hebrew: בליטן טפי - והעצם של בוקא דאטמא דוחק הבשר ומדובק, ודוחק בו את מוח החוט הנפצל עליו, עד שנעשה דק ואינו ניכר:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:20:3.english: They jut out too much - And the bone of the hip socket presses the flesh and adheres [closely], and presses against it the marrow of the cord that branches over it, until it becomes thin and is not discernible.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:21:1.hebrew: עד אחת - כ"מ שיפסק מן הצואר עד בין הפרשה ראשונה — טרפה. נפסק בין הפרשה שלישית — כשרה. שניה — איני יודע:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:21:1.english: Until the first - Wherever it is severed, from the neck until the first branching, [the animal is] a tereifa. [If] it is severed at the third branching, [it is] kosher. [As for the] second, I do not know.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:3:2.english: [The] small chamber - It has many small chambers around it.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:3:3.english: The large bronchus - The middle [bronchus] in the main lobe of the lung.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:4:1.hebrew: התם לבית הסמפונות קתני - ולא תני לבית הסמפון, אבל הכא לא תני לבית החללים, אלא לבית חללו:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:4:1.english: There, it teaches: To the bronchi - And it does not teach, “to the bronchus.” But here, it does not teach, “to the chambers,” but rather, “to its chamber.”

Rashi on Chullin 45b:5:1.english: The artery of the heart - [The Gemara] explains [this] below.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:5:2.hebrew: במשהו - אם ניקב. כל חלב מקרי חלב, בין טמא בין טהור, ושומן אינו אלא לשון חכמים, כגון גבי "שתי חתיכות, אחת של חלב ואחת של שומן", דעל כרחך קרי ליה שומן משום דגבי חלב תנייה:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:5:2.english: In any amount - If it is perforated. All fat is called chelev, whether forbidden or permitted; and shuman is only the language of the Sages, such as regarding "two pieces, one of chelev and one of shuman," where perforce [the Tanna] calls it shuman because he taught it alongside chelev.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:6:1.english: On the sides - [The fat] that descends upon the ribs from the spine.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:6:2.hebrew: על גבי דפנות ס"ד - ומאי חיותא תליא ביה:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:6:2.english: On the sides, can it enter your mind? - And what vitality depends on it?

Rashi on Chullin 45b:6:3.english: That [which is] on the sides of the lung - A fatty tube that descends between the two rows of the lung, and is attached to the spine and connected to the cavity of the heart.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:7:1.hebrew: תלתא קני הוו - לאחר שהקנה נכנס לחזה, מתפצל לשלשה:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:7:1.english: There are three ducts - After the windpipe enters the chest, it branches into three.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:7:2.hebrew: חד פריש לריאה - ומתחלק בתוכה, והן הן סמפונות:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:7:2.english: One separates to the lung - And it divides within it, and these are the bronchial tubes.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:7:3.english: [The duct] of the lung is like the lung - [It renders a tereifa] with a perforation of any size.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:7:4.hebrew: דכבדא כי כבדא - עד שינטל כולו, כדתנן (לעיל חולין מב.) גבי כבד: ולא נשתייר ממנה כלום:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:7:4.english: [The duct] of the liver is like the liver - [It does not render the animal a tereifa] until it is entirely removed, as we learned in the Mishnah (above, Chullin 42a) regarding the liver: "And nothing remained of it."

Rashi on Chullin 45b:7:5.english: [Regarding the duct] of the heart, they disagree - Rav and Shmuel [disagreed] above.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:8:1.hebrew: מתני איפכא - דריאה עד שינטל ככבדא, ודכבדא כי ריאה במשהו, ודליבא פליגי רב ושמואל. וכלישנא קמא מסתברא, דהא קם ליה רבי יוחנן כוותיה, דאמר לעיל: ניקב למטה מן החזה — נידון כריאה:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:8:1.english: Teaches the opposite - [The duct] of the lung [does not render the animal a tereifa] until it is removed, like the liver; and [the duct] of the liver [renders it a tereifa] like the lung, with any amount [of perforation]; and regarding [the duct] of the heart, Rav and Shmuel disagree. And the first version is more reasonable, for Rabbi Yochanan stands in accordance with it, as he said above: [If the windpipe was] perforated below the chest, it is judged like the lung.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:9:1.hebrew: אמרה לשמעתא דרב - דאמר במשהו — קמיה דשמואל. ואכתי לא הוה שמיע ליה, דרב בסורא הוה ראש ישיבה והתם הוה אמר שמעתתיה, ושמואל הוה בנהרדעא:
Rashi on Chullin 45b:9:1.english: Stated Rav’s teaching - That [Rav] said [it renders a tereifa] in any amount — [he stated this] before Shmuel. And [Shmuel] had not yet heard it, for Rav was the head of the yeshiva in Sura and there he would state his teachings, and Shmuel was in Neharde'a.

Rashi on Chullin 45b:9:2.hebrew: אבא - רב. הכי הוה קרי ליה שמואל, דרב הוה עדיף מיניה. אני שמעתי: "אבא", ואית דגרסי: "אבא חברי":
Rashi on Chullin 45b:9:2.english: Abba - [This refers to] Rav. This is what Shmuel would call him, for Rav was greater than him. I heard [the reading]: "Abba", and some read: "Abba, my colleague."

Tosafot on Chullin 45b:13:1.hebrew: מאן דאמר רוב עורו רוב מוחו מאי - דדלמא ה"ה ברוב מוחו לבד טרפה, ונקט רוב עורו לאשמועינן דאפילו עורו בעי רוב. ורבינו תם מפרש: דמבעי ליה אי בעי נמי רוב מוחו, ועורו דנקט מפני שהוא עיקר, ומכל מקום בלא מוחו נמי אינה טריפה:
Tosafot on Chullin 45b:13:1.english: According to the one who says the majority of its meninges, what about the majority of its nerve tissue? - For perhaps the same applies, [that] with the majority of its nerve tissue alone [being severed] it is a tereifah, and he mentioned "the majority of its meninges" to teach us that even its meninges require a majority. And Rabbeinu Tam explains that the inquiry is whether he also requires the majority of its nerve tissue [to be severed as well], and that he mentioned its meninges because it is primary, but nevertheless without its nerve tissue [also severed], it is likewise not a tereifah.

Tosafot on Chullin 45b:18:1.hebrew: נתמזמז מוחיה דדין - תימה לריב"ם, דמייתי ראיה ממוח דראש — דשיעורו בנקב משהו — למוח חוט השדרה, דשיעורו ברובו:
Tosafot on Chullin 45b:18:1.english: "This [man’s] brain has softened and been emptied" - [This is] a wonder to the Rivam, that [the Gemara] brings a proof from the brain of the head — whose measure [to render a tereifa] is with a perforation of any amount — to the marrow of the spinal cord, whose measure is in its majority.

Tosafot on Chullin 45b:8:1.hebrew: מר בר חייא מתני איפכא - פי' בקונטרס דמסתברא כלישנא קמא, דקים ליה רבי יוחנן בשיטתיה לעיל, דאמר: ניקב הקנה למטה מן החזה נידון כריאה. ונראה דאזלינן בכולהו לחומרא, מדלא איתמר הלכתא לא כמר ולא כמר. וגם רבי יוחנן דאמר "ניקב הקנה למטה מן החזה", משמע: בין דריאה בין דכבדא נדון כריאה. וכן רבינו חננאל פסק לחומרא, דשלשתן נקובתן במשהו — בין דכבד, בין דלב, בין דריאה:
Tosafot on Chullin 45b:8:1.english: Mar bar Ḥiyya teaches the opposite - The Kuntres [Rashi] explained that it is reasonable [to rule] in accordance with the first version, as Rabbi Yochanan's [position] earlier aligns with its approach, where he said: [If] the windpipe was punctured below the chest, it is judged like the lung. But it appears [to Tosafot] that we follow the stringent [ruling] in all of them, since the halakhah was stated neither like this Master nor like that Master. And furthermore, that which Rabbi Yochanan said, "[If] the windpipe was punctured below the chest," implies that whether [it is the duct] of the lung or of the liver, it is judged like the lung. And so Rabbeinu Ḥananel ruled stringently: that for all three of them, their perforation in any amount [renders the animal a tereifa] — whether [the duct] of the liver, whether of the heart, or whether of the lung.
